notes.title: WordSpiral – Recent Update – Challenge mode
notes.notes:
The WordSpiral Word Search game has been updated to introduce the new weekly Challenge Mode game. WordSpiral is where you connect neighboring letters on a game board to form words that are removed from the board. Each Sunday a special Spiral game board is released for players to compete against each other for the highest score. Play as many times as you wish during the week and watch the leaderboard. 

Check the website [url=https://WordSpiral.Website]https://WordSpiral.Website[/url] for more information.

notes.title: New modernized WordSpiral game released
notes.notes: WordSpiral is now a Unity-based modernized game from the original legacy version. This new platform greatly expands the game features and prepares for the introduction of "Challenge Mode". Players will be able to compete with each other against a common game board and submit their scores to the leaderboard. Detail are at the website https://wordspiral.website

notes.title: Updates coming soon
notes.notes:
A new more robust version of WordSpiral is coming soon. The existing game is being replaced with a Unity version of the game which will allow us to introduce "Challange Mode". This pits game players against each other in weekly common games. A new scoring system is being introduced and a leaderboard will show how your challenge mode game score compares to others. Play as many times as you wish each week for the top score. 

This update will be available free of charge to all users.
